definitions.sizing: floor(entry NAV / (raw entry price * 50)), fixed contracts until exit; entry notional cap 1x
definitions.low_direction: Entry ER60 < 0.25; ER60 = abs(close-close[-60])/sum(abs(one-bar close changes),60). This is a proxy, not a causal label.
definitions.fast_failure: Net loss, raw price loss, signal exit within 6 subsequent signal bars, MFE < entry ATR20.
definitions.mfe: Raw minute favorable extreme from entry through minute before exit, plus raw exit price; measured from raw entry. Period-end close includes final minute. No costs included in MFE.
definitions.quick_reentry: Losing signal-exit trade followed by next trade in same direction within 6 completed signal bars; retrospective and overlaps other labels.
definitions.limitation: Uses frozen complete-hour build and original joint-system quantities. Post-selection diagnosis, not a filter backtest or causal attribution.
